Hi Carla — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today’s demo and two asks so we can size a scoped proposal:  

1) Estimated monthly token volumes (avg prompt + reply tokens): you said ~120M tokens/month baseline with peaks to ~240M for pilot scope. Please confirm a realistic 90th percentile peak and an optimistic steady-state.  
2) Budget band and target unit economics: you mentioned wanting to keep hosting + inference <= $3,000 / 1M tokens for US region. Confirm if that’s target all-in (including caching/batching savings) or just inference spend.

As promised, I’m attaching a lightweight worksheet to capture traffic shape. If you can fill the shaded columns (average prompt length, avg completion length, %streaming), I’ll run a regional cost comparison (US vs EU) and show the impact of data-residency (VPC) on unit cost.  

Next steps:  
- Carla: fill the Greencore_est_usage.xlsx and send back by Tue (2/24) if possible.  
- Me/Marissa: produce a short memo with per-1M token unit economics for US and EU, with two scenarios (hosted, private VPC).  

Thanks — enjoyed the product questions and the thoughtful cost constraints.  

—Rishi

Carla — thanks for the fast reply and for looping procurement. Per your questions I ran two quick scenarios (attached memo) and pasted the distilled numbers below so procurement has something concise to review. I also flagged assumptions so we stay aligned. If you want a one-page PDF for procurement I can produce that today.

Key assumptions (config):
- Model: open-l1-small (chat gen), typical avg prompt 80 tokens / completion 160 tokens (ratio 1:2)
- Baseline monthly tokens: 120,000,000; Peak bursts to 300,000,000 (handled with burst capacity)
- Caching & batching: conservative 20% token saving on completions from prefix reuse; aggressive 35% if reuse-heavy.

Summary unit economics (per 1M request tokens, rounded):
- US hosted (multi-tenant, default residency): $2,300 / 1M tokens (with conservative 20% savings)
- US private VPC (customer-managed networking + dedicated pool): $3,100 / 1M tokens (extra networking/ops + reserved capacity premium)
- EU hosted (data residency within EU region): $2,700 / 1M tokens (higher infra costs + export control overheads)
- EU private VPC: $3,450 / 1M tokens

Notes on deltas:
- Primary drivers: reserved GPU capacity premiums (~20–25% depending on commit), network & KMS routing for VPC (~$0.01–0.03/token at our current scales in the memo), and slightly higher instance pricing in EU cloud regions.
- Caching/batching materially changes unit price — if Greencore can use prefix caching aggressively, you hit the lower bound (US hosted ~$1,900 / 1M).
- For short bursts (300M), reusable batching helps but you may need temporary burst pools; we can model burst cost amortized across month or as a separate line item.

Attached: Redwood_us-eu-pricing-memo.pdf (2-page memo) and the updated worksheet (Greencore_est_usage.xlsx) with my filled-in cells.  

Requested next steps:  
- Carla: confirm whether procurement expects the $3k / 1M to be all-in or just inference; if all-in you’re under the cap in US hosted.  
- Procurement: if you want us to produce an SOW for private VPC numbers / reserved commitment options, we can draft on 1- or 3-month pilot structures.  

If it’s helpful, Marissa can outline the reserved capacity pricing bands — Marissa, can you add a 12-month commit vs 3-month pilot delta in a short note?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with procurement if they prefer a walkthrough.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
